_readme: v2. Decided by design owner's brief: plays like Sister Location (nights, scripted facility, animatronic AI) with multiplayer, but the player keeps ALL of Minecraft: every item, crafting, inventory/menus, creative AND survival. Remaining null = must be measured/verified in the build. Unbuilt and untested.

games.note: Not in Melty catalog. Mod finds the Steam install, reads art/sound at runtime, shows an in-game message if missing. Nothing from SL is shipped. No look-alikes.

world_modes.stakes: real: caught = eliminated for the night, items kept (no loss)
caught = respawn at elevator, no elimination
world_modes.flight: disabled during active night, enabled in lobby/builder

world_modes.note: between nights: build defenses, decorate, test animatronics non-lethal

minecraft_integration_rules.rule: Full vanilla inventory, crafting, chests, furnaces, enchanting, brewing stay usable in the facility.

Players can place/break blocks inside the facility except protected 'set' blocks (walls, floors of SL rooms, doors' frames) so rooms stay intact each night. Placed blocks reset between nights unless the host enables Persistent mode.

Vanilla items interact with the mashup: torches/lamps ward off Funtime Foxy rushes, doors/trapdoors/iron bars slow animatronics, noteblocks/jukebox lure Ballora, redstone powers Primary Control tasks, shields block one grab.
Vanilla hostile mobs disabled inside the facility dimension (mod animatronics are the threat); normal in overworld.
Overworld, Nether and End remain playable; the facility is an added dimension reached via the lobby elevator.
Vanilla pause menu, advancements, chat, commands (for ops) unchanged.

roles.name: Animatronic
roles.abilities: one signature ability on a 20s cooldown; cannot break protected blocks; vents open to it
roles.win: catch every guard before the night goal is met

animatronics.name: Circus Baby
animatronics.ability: voice lure draws guards to a chosen room, then grab

animatronics.name: Ballora
animatronics.ability: hunts footsteps/noise (blocks placed, chests, jukebox); standing still and sneaking hides you

animatronics.name: Funtime Freddy
animatronics.ability: ambush from stage room; stuffs one guard into the suit (one-hit)

animatronics.name: Funtime Foxy
animatronics.ability: rushes through dark rooms; light blocks it

animatronics.name: Ennard
animatronics.ability: roams every room on night 5; ignores doors (needs iron blocks to stall)

nights.scaling: difficulty +1 every 3 minutes, Ennard from minute 1
nights.winner_rule: score = time survived; no fixed end

multiplayer.max_players_note: design target: 1 animatronic + up to 7 guards; confirm under load in two-instance testing
multiplayer.note: Needs a relay/lobby Melty accepts. Do not mark multiplayer-connect until hosting and joining were tested with two running copies.

listing.title: Fazbear Facility: Sister Location in Minecraft
listing.tagline: Survive five nights in a Sister Location facility, with all of Minecraft in your hands.
listing.description: DRAFT, unbuilt. Pick night guard or animatronic in the lobby, drop into a Sister Location facility, and survive timers, task nights and an endless night, solo or with friends. Keep full Minecraft: crafting, items, menus, creative and survival. Requires Minecraft Java and your own copy of Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location.
